summary: Fix Point coordinate validation under evaluate(False) by checking whether im(a).is_zero is False instead of testing the truthiness of an unevaluated imaginary-part expression. Added regression coverage for the reported Point2D string parsing, direct Point2D/Point3D/general Point construction with real coordinates, float preservation, and rejection of imaginary coordinates. Reproduced the original ValueError and confirmed the new regression fails before the fix. Public geometry suite passed after the fix: 111 passed, 4 skipped (python bin/test sympy/geometry/tests --no-colors --no-subprocess). Reviewed the final diff; no full-repository suite or hidden tests run.
